long_biography.plain_text:
While working as a keyboard player for Mosconcert and the jazz ensemble Allegro, Alexey Kurochkin saw how difficult it was for Soviet musicians to obtain quality Western instruments. In 1990 he partnered with guitarist Alexander Sitkovetsky to import Fender guitars, then added leading microphone, keyboard, drum and professional-audio brands. The resulting A&T Trade network grew through exclusive distribution agreements, regional offices and retail stores.

Kurochkin used that platform to launch businesses beyond music. A&T created the internet-telephony operator Zebra Telecom, where he chaired the board before its controlling stake was sold to Rostelecom in 2006. Premium Yachts made him a leading dealer for Ferretti Group marques in Russia and later a Sanlorenzo partner. His career combines a musician's product knowledge with a repeated pattern of importing, distributing and building specialist brands.
